entries.title: I Peter 2:1
segments: Therefore laying aside all malice and all guile and hypocrisies and envyings, and all evil speakings,

entries.title: I Peter 2:2
segments: desire the sincere milk of the word, as newborn babes, so that you may grow by it;

entries.title: I Peter 2:3
segments: if truly you have tasted that the Lord [is] gracious.

entries.title: I Peter 2:4
segments: For having been drawn to Him, a living Stone, indeed rejected by men, but elect, precious with God;

entries.title: I Peter 2:5
segments: you also as living stones are built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 2:6
segments: Therefore also it is contained in the Scripture: "Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner Stone, elect, precious, and he who believes on Him shall never be ashamed."

entries.title: I Peter 2:7
segments: Therefore to you who believe [is] the honor. But to those who are disobedient, [He is the] Stone which the builders rejected; this One came to be [the] Head of the corner,

entries.title: I Peter 2:8
segments: and a Stone-of-stumbling and a Rock-of-offense to those disobeying, who stumble at the word, to which they also were appointed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:9
segments: But you [are] a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for possession, so that you might speak of the praises of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

entries.title: I Peter 2:10
segments: [you] who then were not a people, but now the people of God, those not pitied [then], but now pitied.

entries.title: I Peter 2:11
segments: Dearly beloved, I exhort [you] as [temporary] residents and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

entries.title: I Peter 2:12
segments: having your conduct honest among the nations, in that which they speak against you as evildoers, they may glorify God in a day of [His] visitation, seeing [your] good works.

entries.title: I Peter 2:13
segments: Then be in obedience to every ordinance of men, because of the Lord, whether to a king as supreme,

entries.title: I Peter 2:14
segments: or to governors as sent by Him for vengeance [on] evildoers, but for praise [on] well-doers.

entries.title: I Peter 2:15
segments: For such is the will of God, doing good to silence the ignorance of foolish men;

entries.title: I Peter 2:16
segments: as free, and not having freedom as a cover of evil, but as servants of God.

entries.title: I Peter 2:17
segments: Honor all. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

entries.title: I Peter 2:18
segments: Servants, [be] subject to [your] masters with all fear, not only to those good and forbearing, but also to the perverse ones.

entries.title: I Peter 2:19
segments: For this [is] a grace, if for conscience [toward] God anyone endures grief, suffering wrongfully.

entries.title: I Peter 2:20
segments: For what glory [is it] if you patiently endure [while] sinning and being buffeted? But if you suffer [while] doing good, and patiently endure, this [is] a grace from God.

entries.title: I Peter 2:21
segments: For you were not called to this? For Christ also suffered on our behalf, leaving us an example, that you should follow His steps,

entries.title: I Peter 2:22
segments: He who did no sin, nor was guile found in His mouth,

entries.title: I Peter 2:23
segments: who when He was reviled did not revile in return. When He suffered, He did not threaten, but gave [Himself] up to Him who judges righteously.

entries.title: I Peter 2:24
segments: [He] Himself bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that dying to sins, we might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:25
segments: For you were as sheep going astray, but now you are turned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
